An American prairie vignette with grassland, a bison and granite mountains bearing a small respectful four-face carved monument silhouette; South Dakota geography mnemonic, no compass arrow.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — exclusive (a.独占的，独家的): One reporter receives a story folder from a source while other reporters wait outside a closed door, privileged sole access.
TOP RIGHT — South (南达科他州(美国)): An American prairie vignette with grassland, a bison and granite mountains bearing a small respectful four-face carved monument silhouette; South Dakota geography mnemonic, no compass arrow.
BOTTOM LEFT — perpetual (a.永久的): A circular sequence of four candle silhouettes, each relighting the next through small blue arrows; endless repeated continuation, no clock endpoint.
BOTTOM RIGHT — nursery (n.育婴室，保育室): A calm nursery room with several safe infant cribs, a changing table and an attentive caregiver.
review_notes: All four cells visually checked: one reporter gets sole access while others wait; South Dakota mnemonic has Mount Rushmore and bison; circular replacement sequence conveys perpetual continuation; separate cribs and caregiver make a safe nursery. Complete objects fit inside quadrant boundaries.
